verdict.rationale: SerpApi provides an official MCP server (serpapi-mcp) for agent-framework consumption, an llms.txt, and markdown-formatted output explicitly 'optimized for LLMs and AI agents,' showing real AI-agent tooling investment. However, there's no evidence of a published OpenAPI/function-calling schema (openapi.json probes all 404), so 'ready-made' function-calling schema support is unconfirmed.
